text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- South African President Nelson Mandela is due in Maputo on Friday to attend Saturday's opening of the 12-nation Southern African Development Community's Theatre Festival.

- Afonso Dhlakama, leader of Mozambique's former rebel movement Renamo, is returning to the central district of Maringue, which once housed the movement's military headquarters, and plans to stay there for two months. A Renamo press release said Dhlakama intends to investigate alleged "provocations" by the Mozambican police.

- Mozambican police have dismantled two arms caches, containing between them about 70 firearms, in the northern province of Cabo Delgado. The caches were found in Nairoto, in Montepuez district, in a region that had housed a base of the Renamo rebels during the civil war.
